notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hey, capybara seekers!

In this update, we've fixed a rare bug reported by one of the players and improved the quality of effects.

Full changelog:

- Fixed a very rare bug that caused unintended camera movement without player input.
- Increased the quality of visual effects when clicking on a capybara and upon finding all capybaras.
- Optimized some graphics, which should result in a significant reduction in the game's disk size.
